content:
jess (docs): Quick FYI — the hero image on /docs/getting-started is 404ing for a subset of users (reported in onboarding). Can someone check? :eyes:

docs-bot: link-checker: /docs/getting-started -> assets/img/gs-hero.png returned 404

andre (eng): Which markdown file references it?

jess (docs): /docs/getting-started/index.md
Image line:
```
![Getting started hero](/assets/img/gs-hero.png)
```
I think the assets bucket name changed last month from `redwood-assets` -> `redwood-public-assets` and the absolute path broke in the build.

mike (devex): If it's just a path we can change to relative `/static/img/gs-hero.png` in the repo and add a redirect rule for older absolute paths in the CDN.

olivia (product): I can open a tiny PR to swap the path and add alt text if you want me to.

jess (docs): that'd be awesome, thanks @olivia. add `alt=\"Getting started hero\"` while you're in there.

olivia (product): done — PR at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/452

Patch:
```diff
- ![Getting started hero](/assets/img/gs-hero.png)
+ ![Getting started hero](/static/img/gs-hero.png)
```

andre (eng): pinging @mike for quick review on CDN redirect config.

mike (devex): LGTM for the content change. I'll add the CDN redirect rule: `^/assets/img/(.*) -> /static/img/$1` live in 10m.

andre (eng): quick CR from me — tiny nit: compress the image a bit (20% smaller). other than that lgtm.

olivia (product): addressed compression and pushed the change.

andre (eng): lgtm, merging.

docs-bot: deploy-started: docs-site v2026.3.17-olivia-452

jess (docs): thanks y'all — can someone confirm it's fixed on prod? :pray:

mike (devex): verified in US region on Chrome and Safari, image renders and alt shows on hover.

docs-bot: deploy-succeeded: docs-site v2026.3.17-olivia-452

jess (docs): perfect, closing the loop. I'll add a tiny note to the asset migration doc about absolute paths.

olivia (product): thanks team :tada:
